Package dev.turboism.sdk.task

Interface TaskHandle

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
public interface TaskHandle extends AutoCloseable
Plugin-owned lifecycle handle for an accepted or rejected task submission.

Handles are not reusable. Closing an active handle is equivalent to cancellation and does not shut down the scheduler. A rejected submission still returns a non-null terminal handle, allowing callers to inspect one uniform completion shape.

    • cancel

      boolean cancel()
      Requests cooperative cancellation.

      Cancellation prevents a queued action where possible and signals a running action's CancellationToken. It cannot roll back side effects already performed by plugin code.

      Returns:
      true only when cancellation changed a non-terminal task to canceled

    • completion

      CompletionStage<TaskOutcome> completion()
      Returns the terminal task outcome stage.

      For a one-shot task, normal completion is success, failure, timeout, cancellation, or rejection. For a fixed-delay task, successful runs update progress but do not complete this stage. The runtime settles the stage and dispatches ordinary dependent callbacks through the plugin's bounded executor; explicitly asynchronous callbacks may use their chosen executor.

      Returns:
      a stage for the terminal outcome
